description: A binary translator both ways — binary to text, text to binary, hex and decimal too. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

input.description: Plain text, or bytes written as binary, hex, decimal or octal. Groups may be separated by spaces or commas; hex also accepts 0x prefixes and unspaced pairs. Every other representation of the same bytes comes back at once, so there is no direction to choose. Text is treated as UTF-8, so "é" is two bytes.

readAs.description: How to read input. auto (the default) works it out: only 0s and 1s in whole bytes is binary, hex digits with a letter or 0x is hex, several zero-padded pairs is hex, several numbers up to 255 is decimal, anything else is text. Octal is never guessed, since "17" is valid octal and decimal, so name it explicitly. Byte values over 255 are refused.

name: binary_translator
title: Binary Translator
